# E0427: a projection can't raise

A projection's call is a place, which `try` can't mark, so a projection can't raise. Check before calling it, or panic on a bad index.

- Rule: [`projections.cannot-raise`](../../reference/13-modes.md#projections.cannot-raise)
- Reported at: the `raise<E>` element of the projection's row.
- Tier: `advanced`, checked in the `items` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0427:3
type OutOfRange = | OutOfRange

fn at(inout xs: List<i64>, i: i64) -> inout i64 / raise<OutOfRange> {
  yield xs[i]
}
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
fn at(inout xs: List<i64>, i: i64) -> inout i64 {
  yield xs[i]
}
```
